encounter: P12 play_order 135, E0161 TRAINER_JUSTIN (casual), Route110 Trick House puzzle 3, cap 42
availability_audit: Chronology anchor: this battle sits at play_order 135, after Ashen Woods (play_order 133-134) and before Norman's Balance Badge, so the live cap is 42 and Surf is not yet available. The Trick House itself is on Route 110, which the player first walked in C16-C17, but by the time puzzle 3 is open the player has cleared Flannery, so the whole Act 1 map set up to Ember Path is legal. Every member is in work/reference-pools/pool-42.json with gate <= 42. Route 118 and New Mauville sources are excluded (Surf, C27/C28). No legendary, mythical, Ultra Beast or Paradox species is used.
plan: Justin's four are entirely physical and three of them are Dark or part-Dark. Intimidate and Fake Out from Incineroar tax the whole team; Fairy is 2x into Malamar and Cacturne; Bug is 4x into Cacturne and 2x into Malamar; Flying and Fire are 2x into Cacturne. Vikavolt's Levitate blanks Bouffalant's High Horsepower outright and its Bug Buzz is the single best attack on my side. Amoonguss holds Spore for a Contrary Malamar that would otherwise grow every turn it uses Superpower. Declared in advance: Bouffalant's Soundproof should make Mega Gardevoir's Pixilate Hyper Voice fail against that slot specifically, and Cacturne's Water Absorb and Spiky Shield mean I bring no Water move and accept contact damage on Spiky Shield turns.
